zh.name: 深渊禁潮
zh.description: 对全体敌人造成<color=#02ff00>400%</color>攻击力的伤害，并施加"深渊禁咒"，持续<color=#02ff00>6</color>秒（深渊禁咒：持续期间无法释放终结技，并每秒损失<color=#02ff00>50</color>点能量）

upgrades.zh: 等级2："深渊禁咒"持续时间提升至<color=#02ff00>7</color>秒
等级3：每秒损失能量提高至<color=#02ff00>60</color>点
upgrades.en: Energy lost per second increased to 60.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：造成伤害提升至<color=#02ff00>450%</color>攻击力

en.name: Abyssal Tide Ban
en.description: Deals 400% ATK as DMG to all enemies and inflicts "Abyssal Interdict" for 6s (Abyssal Interdict: the target cannot cast its ultimate and loses 50 Energy per second).

zh.name: 触须缄默
zh.description: 在能量最高的敌人脚下召唤触手，对其造成<color=#02ff00>150%</color>攻击力的伤害并将其"深渊禁默"<color=#02ff00>3</color>秒（深渊禁默：持续期间无法释放终结技）

upgrades.zh: 等级2：伤害提升至<color=#02ff00>200%</color>攻击力
等级3："深渊禁默"时间提升至<color=#02ff00>5</color>秒
等级4：伤害提升至<color=#02ff00>250%</color>攻击力

en.name: Tentacle Silence
en.description: Summons tentacles beneath the enemy with the most Energy, dealing 150% ATK as DMG and inflicting "Abyssal Silence" for 3s (Abyssal Silence: the target cannot cast its ultimate).

zh.name: 古神逆视
zh.description: 被动的，敌方单位释放终结技时，克苏鲁进入不可选中状态<color=#02ff00>2</color>秒，并在该状态结束时获得<color=#02ff00>150%</color>攻击力的护盾，该效果<color=#02ff00>8</color>秒内只能触发一次

upgrades.zh: 等级2：在该状态结束时获得<color=#02ff00>200%</color>攻击力的护盾
upgrades.en: Gains a shield equal to 200% ATK when this state ends.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：不可选中状态时间提升至<color=#02ff00>3</color>秒
等级4：克苏鲁即将阵亡时会额外触发一次该效果，一场战斗只能触发一次
upgrades.en: When Cthulhu is about to fall, this effect triggers one additional time. Can trigger only once per battle.

en.name: Elder Gaze Reversed
en.description: Passive: when an enemy unit casts its ultimate, Cthulhu becomes untargetable for 2s and gains a shield equal to 150% ATK when this state ends. This effect can trigger only once every 8s.

zh.name: 古神压制
zh.description: 对全体敌人造成<color=#02ff00>150%</color>攻击力的伤害，同时降低命中敌人<color=#02ff00>20%</color>的攻击力，持续<color=#02ff00>8</color>秒，目标若处于"深渊禁咒"状态，改为<color=#02ff00>300%</color>攻击力的伤害并降低命中敌人<color=#02ff00>40%</color>攻击力

upgrades.zh: 等级2：伤害提升至<color=#02ff00>200%</color>攻击力，目标若处于"深渊禁咒"状态伤害提升至<color=#02ff00>400%</color>攻击力
upgrades.en: Damage increased to 200% ATK; if the target is under "Abyssal Interdict", damage increased to 400% ATK.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：攻击力降低效果提升至<color=#02ff00>25%</color>，目标若处于"深渊禁咒"状态攻击力降低效果提升至<color=#02ff00>50%</color>
upgrades.en: ATK reduction increased to 25%; if the target is under "Abyssal Interdict", ATK reduction increased to 50%.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：伤害提升至<color=#02ff00>250%</color>攻击力，目标若处于"深渊禁咒"状态伤害提升至<color=#02ff00>500%</color>攻击力
upgrades.en: Damage increased to 250% ATK; if the target is under "Abyssal Interdict", damage increased to 500% ATK.

en.name: Elder Suppression
en.description: Deals 150% ATK as DMG to all enemies and reduces the ATK of enemies hit by 20% for 8s. If the target is under "Abyssal Interdict", it instead takes 300% ATK as DMG and its ATK is reduced by 40%.

levels.zh: "深渊禁咒"期间敌人所有能量恢复效果降低<color=#02ff00>30%</color>
levels.en: While under "Abyssal Interdict", all Energy regeneration effects of enemies are reduced by 30%.

levels.zh: 每名敌人首次进入"深渊禁咒"时，立即损失<color=#02ff00>100</color>点能量
levels.en: The first time each enemy is afflicted by "Abyssal Interdict", it immediately loses 100 Energy.

levels.zh: 每名敌人首次进入"深渊禁咒"时，立即损失<color=#02ff00>200</color>点能量
levels.en: The first time each enemy is afflicted by "Abyssal Interdict", it immediately loses 200 Energy.

levels.zh: 每名敌人首次即将释放终结技时，对其造成<color=#02ff00>300%</color>攻击力的伤害，并使其"深渊禁默"<color=#02ff00>3</color>秒
levels.en: The first time each enemy is about to cast its ultimate, it takes 300% ATK as DMG and is inflicted with "Abyssal Silence" for 3s.
